title: What If Earth Stopped Spinning for One Second?
description:
Earth's surface at the equator moves at about 1,670 km/h. If the planet suddenly stopped turning, everything not bolted to the rock (you, the air, the oceans) would keep moving east at that speed. And if it never started again, the Sun would take a whole year to cross the sky: one day would last a year.

Sources: NASA Space Place / Earth rotation speed (about 465 m/s at the equator); USGS and NASA Q&A "What if Earth stopped spinning?".
Narration is AI-generated (ElevenLabs) and the pictures are AI-generated illustrations. This is a thought experiment: Earth cannot actually stop.

#shorts #whatif #earth #space #science
